traceability_notes: The independent Phase 3 audit returned revise/soft_judgment with no hard-floor blocker.

All three revision targets were applied: H_C now includes the negative control and direct-baseline hypotheses, the worker is reducer-agnostic, and literature deltas are matched admission/error-rate comparisons.

The proposed novelty is limited to the eligibility/certificate admission decision and explicitly excludes pruning, subset search, SCC condensation, provenance, equivalence testing, dependency closure, and local one-deletion minimality.

The scoop-check decision remains revise because all direct neighbors partially overlap. Candidate-specific terms were not transmitted to external services, so behavior-preserving program reduction and statistical delta debugging remain unresolved threats.
Passing this stage means the revision resolved the IdeaSpark Phase 3 targets; it does not convert the provisional novelty judgment into an established first-of-kind result.
